There are many things I'm grateful for today. But it's been a long day so I won't go into everything.

- I'm grateful to God, for getting me through the worse 17 months of my life.

&nbsp;

- I'm grateful to my Mom, Mom In Love, Friends, and Family who have gotten me through the worst days.

&nbsp;

- I'm especially grateful for the Widow/Widower community I've met through the various Facebook Groups online. They have been a source of encouragement and strength.

One such Wid-Sister, [Adrianne](https://www.griefsucks.org/p/about-us.html), and I started a new project together. We both got busy this summer and I'm grateful for her patience as I promised her I'd keep with it if she kept bugging me.

So I'd like to announce [GriefSucks.org](https://www.griefsucks.org/p/start-here_29.html). It's been and will continue to be a project of love that we will work on as time permits. There are some amazing articles she wrote from her perspective as a Widow and I plan to add some from my perspective as a Widower. So far, she wrote a lot and I edited a lot. I'm grateful for her talent as a writer.

Please check it out and [subscribe](https://feedburner.google.com/fb/a/mailverify?uri=griefsucks/moHf&amp;loc=en_US) to that project as well!

And with that short post, I wish you a fond farewell for the evening.
